note.text: Newly identified in-office diagnosis: the periapical radiograph revealed early periapical pathology not visible in the virtual assessment. CODE CORRECTION (project verification discipline): the source use-case document labels this 'K04.5 — Periapical abscess without sinus', but ICD-10-CM K04.5 is 'Chronic apical periodontitis'; 'Periapical abscess without sinus' is K04.7 (consistent with the code used in UC02a's claims-sharing EOB). K04.7 is used here per the clinical narrative ('periapical rarefaction consistent with periapical abscess'). Tooth #19 uses the ADA Universal Numbering System; FDI is deliberately NOT asserted.
